title: Doirani | Dojran
tagline: Doirani [Dojran] is a small cross-border lake between Greece and North Macedonia
synopsis: Doirani [Dojran] is a small cross-border lake between Greece and North Macedonia. Observing the landscape and everyday life across four seasons, the documentary portrays the lake as both a place that connects and a border that divides, revealing how nature, memory, and the rhythms of daily life quietly shape the relationship between people and place.
